Forensic Field Guide

I. Global System Metrics

Slate Heat Index Opportunity

Quantifies the day’s total volume of unpriced alpha. High heat means the board is target-rich.

System Status Infrastructure

Confirms the Statcast-driven feed is active, synchronized, and processing ballistic metadata.

Edge Score 0–100 Rank

Signal strength relative to baseline. Higher scores indicate stronger deviation from market expectation.

2.4Σ Verification Gate

High-conviction threshold used to separate signal from noise before a roster command becomes actionable.

II. Pitching // Ballistic Signals

IVB Pitch Physics

Induced vertical break. ERA reports history; IVB measures the physical ability to miss barrels now.

Stuff+ Disruption Surveillance

Tracks unpriced shifts in velocity, spin, movement, and pitch nastiness before the box score reacts.

Whiff % Swing Dynamics

Recent swing-and-miss rate. Measures deception, finish, and current miss-ability.

FB Velo + Extension Kinetic Output

Velocity plus release extension. More extension shrinks the hitter’s reaction window.

III. Hitting // Kinetic Signals

Avg EV / EV Burst Kinetic Output

Exit velocity baseline and sudden velocity jumps versus recent norms.

Barrel-Like % Contact Quality

Custom quality-of-contact bucket using launch and velocity vectors.

Blast Rate Power Floor

High bat speed plus squared-up contact. A physical floor for power emergence.

SEAGER Score Behavioral Alpha

Selective Aggression Gauge. Rewards attacking damage-zone strikes while ignoring marginal pitcher’s pitches.

BABIP Luck Filter

Audits whether outcome is misleading by comparing results against contact quality and physical cause layers.

IV. Advanced Forensic Logic

Market Latency Delta Temporal Audit

The gap between DiamondSignals detection and mainstream headline confirmation.

Retail Tax Headline Premium

The cost of waiting for public confirmation instead of acting on forensic movement first.

Recursive Drift Modeling Core Algorithm

Compares new movement and performance data against historical kinetic audits to detect structural drift.
